title: Clinical metrology camera
tables: A 31 MP monochrome global-shutter, 10GigE industrial camera class [S9].
Captures stable, high-resolution whole-plate and well images for dimensional and optical measurement.
Clinical measurement requires repeatability, trigger control, low geometric ambiguity and traceable acquisition settings.
Monochrome global-shutter machine vision avoids Bayer interpolation for edge measurement and supports synchronized illumination; final performance is system-dependent.
